I answered Dana in a thread on her #north-team message. The date in the channel is 21 December for the signed Thornbury Cloth Co. order form. Marcus posted it there on 14 October and nobody has posted a different date since.

That's the date Marcus passed on, but nothing in the channel shows anyone agreeing on it as the final deadline. So I told her to check with Marcus or the account file before she puts it in the tracker as settled. I didn't check the account file myself.
